claude_proposed_widenings.name: passive_initiative_trigger family for ClassFeatureMechanics
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The feature fires automatically when the bard rolls Initiative — not on player activation. The existing ClassFeatureMechanics only has the 'activation' family, which models player-initiated use of a feature with an explicit cost. There is no family for 'passive: fires automatically when a named game event occurs'. This requires a new mechanics family (e.g. 'passive_trigger' or 'initiative_trigger') with a trigger field pointing to the game event (initiative_window) instead of an activationCost.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: When you roll Initiative, you regain expended uses of Bardic Inspiration until you have two if you have fewer than that.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: refill_resource_to_floor (new ClassFeatureEffect variant)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The effect is not grant_extra_action or heal_hp — it sets the bard's Bardic Inspiration use count to at least N (floor=2) if currently below that floor. This is a conditional partial-refill of a named external resource, not a self-heal or extra action. No existing ClassFeatureEffect variant covers 'conditionally top up a separate resource to a minimum value'.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: you regain expended uses of Bardic Inspiration until you have two if you have fewer than that
